articles.summary: CNH Announces Agreement to Form a Joint Venture by Selling a 70% Interest in its Construction Equipment Business to Kobelco Construction Machinery Transforms CNH into a leading, pure-play agriculture equipment, technology, and services company with a strengthened financial profile Creates joint venture that operates as a global manufacturer of construction equipment, with an enhanced ability to invest and innovate to better serve customers Transaction values CNH’s Construction Equipment business
articles.title: CNH Announces Agreement to Form a Joint Venture by Selling a 70% Interest in its Construction Equipment Business to Kobelco Construction Machinery

articles.summary: Consolidated revenues for the third quarter of 2026 were $4.4 billion, approximately flat year over year Reported Net income was $35 million, including a $156 million non-cash charge to establish a valuation allowance against deferred tax assets; Adjusted Net income (1) was $205 million, compared with $109 million in the prior-year quarter Third quarter diluted EPS of $0.02 and adjusted diluted EPS (1) of $0.16 Full year guidance updated with expected IEEPA tariff refund impacts net of one-off uses Announced earlier today an agreement with Kobelco regarding CNH Construction business Basildon, UK - November 9, 2026 - CNH Industrial N.V. (NYSE: CNH) reported Net income for the three months ended September 30, 2026, of $35 million, or $0.02 per basic and diluted share, compared with Net income of $67 million, or $0.06 per basic and diluted share, for the three months ended September 30, 2025.
